preview_heading: Kings meet Kingsmen in Gros Islet
preview: Saint Lucia Kings face Jamaica Kingsmen in CPL 2026 Match 13 at Daren Sammy Cricket Ground. The match is scheduled for Fri 21 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: Roston Chase and Matthew Forde anchor the returning group, joined by Jewel Andrew and a fresh Saint Lucian pathway that includes McKenny Clarke. The CPL's newest franchise restores a Jamaica-based men's team, led by a local group featuring Rovman Powell, Andre Russell and Odean Smith. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
